title: T helper cells expressing fractalkine receptor and bearing T follicular helper 1-like cell functions in patients with IgG4-related disease.
authors: Inoue, Yoshino; Nakayamada, Shingo; Kubo, Satoshi; Yamagata, Kaoru; Sonomoto, Koshiro; Iwata, Shigeru; Miyazaki, Yusuke; Tanaka, Yoshiya
one_liner_zh: 该文研究IgG4相关疾病中表达 fractalkine 受体的CD4+ T细胞亚群功能，属于免疫细胞表型与临床疾病研究，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、转录因子结合或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Because the pathological features of IgG4-related disease (IgG4-RD) include lymphocyte infiltration and fibrotic changes in the lesions, we investigated the significance of fractalkine (CX3CL1) and lymphocyte subsets in patients with IgG4-RD. METHODS: Peripheral blood and biopsied samples were obtained from healthy controls (HCs, n = 10), RA (n = 10) and IgG4-RD patients (n = 16) and were analysed by flow cytometry, immunohistology and costimulation assays. RESULTS: Peripheral CX3CR1+ CD4+ T cells had an approximately 3-fold increase in the IgG4-RD patients (15.4%), compared with the HCs (5.0%). In addition, CX3CR1+ CD4+ T cells were localized in the salivary glands of the IgG4-RD patients but not in those with Sicca syndrome. CX3CR1 was induced on 20% of CD4+ T cells after T-cell receptor (TCR) simulation with IL-12 for five days culture. CX3CR1+ T cells showed high expression of both CXCR5 and CXCR3. Moreover, they co-expressed Bcl-6 and T-bet, the master transcription factors for T helper 1 (Th1) and T follicular helper (Tfh) cells. After secondary stimulation, CX3CR1+ T cells produced both IFN-gamma (IFN-gamma) and IL-21. Compared with their CX3CR1- counterparts, CX3CR1+ CD4+ T cells induced plasmablast differentiation from naive B cells more efficiently (15.0 vs 5.0%) and increased the production of IgG2, IgG3 and IgG4 by B cells. CONCLUSION: CX3CR1+ CD4+ T cells characteristically increased in the peripheral blood and the affected tissues and were associated with an increase in the serum IgG4 levels of patients with IgG4-RD. This CD4 subset has a Th1/Tfh-like phenotype and a B cell helper function.
abstract_zh: 目的：鉴于IgG4相关疾病（IgG4-RD）的病理特征包括病变中的淋巴细胞浸润和纤维化改变，我们研究了fractalkine（CX3CL1）及淋巴细胞亚群在IgG4-RD患者中的意义。方法：从健康对照（HCs，n = 10）、类风湿关节炎（RA，n = 10）和IgG4-RD患者（n = 16）中获取外周血和活检样本，并通过流式细胞术、免疫组织学和共刺激实验进行分析。结果：与健康对照（5.0%）相比，IgG4-RD患者外周血中CX3CR1+ CD4+ T细胞增加了约3倍（15.4%）。此外，CX3CR1+ CD4+ T细胞定位于IgG4-RD患者的唾液腺中，但在干燥综合征患者中未观察到。在T细胞受体（TCR）刺激并加入IL-12培养五天后，20%的CD4+ T细胞上诱导了CX3CR1表达。CX3CR1+ T细胞同时高表达CXCR5和CXCR3。此外，它们共表达Bcl-6和T-bet，这是T辅助1型（Th1）和T滤泡辅助（Tfh）细胞的主要转录因子。在二次刺激后，CX3CR1+ T细胞同时产生干扰素-γ（IFN-γ）和IL-21。与其CX3CR1-对应细胞相比，CX3CR1+ CD4+ T细胞更有效地诱导初始B细胞分化为浆母细胞（15.0%对5.0%），并增加B细胞产生IgG2、IgG3和IgG4的能力。结论：CX3CR1+ CD4+ T细胞在外周血和受累组织中特征性增加，并与IgG4-RD患者血清IgG4水平升高相关。该CD4亚群具有Th1/Tfh样表型和B细胞辅助功能。
